question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

‘One who falsely claims expertise’.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Charlatan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Charlatan"** refers to a person who falsely claims to have knowledge or skills, particularly in a professional field; essentially, a fraud or impostor. (धोखेबाज)
 
 
• **Example:** The self-proclaimed healer was exposed as a charlatan when his patients failed to recover.
 
 
• **Scholar** refers to a learned person who has studied extensively in a particular field of knowledge. (विद्वान)
 
 
• **Example:** The scholar spent years researching ancient manuscripts to uncover historical truths.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct one-word substitute for "one who falsely claims expertise" is **"Charlatan"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Charlatan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scholar** (विद्वान): A person who has a deep understanding of a subject due to extensive study or research.
 
 
• **Example:** Scholars from around the world attended the conference on climate change.
 
 
• **Maestro** (माहिर): A distinguished figure in music or another artistic field, typically someone who excels in their craft.
 
 
• **Example:** The maestro conducted the orchestra with impeccable precision.
 
 
• **Specialist** (विशेषज्ञ): A person highly skilled in a particular area of study or work.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a specialist in pediatric medicine and has saved countless lives.
 

3a:Taa2,

The correct answer is: **Option 1 - clear out**.</p
